title: Make Islam Easy for Beginners
body:
Allah did not send the whole Shariah in one day. It was completed within 23 years. It shows us that the
followers of Muhammad* were improving their prayers step by step. First they were only praying 2 rakats.
After the Night-journey Allah ordered them to pray 5 times. We too must try to make the way easy for new
Muslims.
